_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior fiber cement siding prime+paint. Context prefix FCSD (Fiber Cement SiDing) — no collision with existing prefixes. SDNG_ is taken by SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Combined prime+finish in single spec (same mobilization).

paintable_items.name: Exterior siding field surface
paintable_items.notes: REUSED from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT. Same physical item (siding field), different substrate material. Profile modifier (lap/shingle/panel) adjusts effective surface area and production rate. Add SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC to used_in array.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. Existing prefixes: CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG. FCSD is unique.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_FCSD_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_FCSD_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE, TSK_FCSD_SEAL_CUT_EDGES, TSK_FCSD_PRIME_SPRAY, TSK_FCSD_FINISH_SPRAY_1, TSK_FCSD_SAND_INTERCOAT

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape, hardscape, HVAC, light fixtures
Low-pressure wash, edge seal, caulk siding-to-trim joints, light sand
Field prime — 3 paths: acrylic (factory-primed), alkali-resistant (bare), bonding (factory-finished)
First finish coat — spray only (no back-rolling on fiber cement)
Intercoat inspection, light sand (QT4 only), dust removal

paintscope_keys.description: Net paintable siding field area (square feet)
Boolean flag confirming new construction context. Always true for this NC spec. Used for engine validation — prevents accidental assignment to repaint projects.
paintscope_keys.notes: This spec is NC-only. The flag exists for engine-level scope validation, not runtime branching.

paintscope_keys.description: Linear feet of house perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection. Measured along the foundation/siding line, not landscape area.
Count of exterior light fixtures to mask
Count of HVAC condenser units to cover

quality_tier.notes: QT5 excluded — not applicable to siding field per Exterior_Substrates_Doctrine §5.4. QT2 is economy (single finish coat acceptable on primed surfaces).

application_method.notes: Spray is primary for fiber cement. Brush_roll is fallback for <750 SF, occupied adjacent, or high wind. Back-rolling is explicitly AVOIDED on fiber cement (introduces unwanted texture). spray_backroll and spray_rolloff are NOT valid for this spec.

sheen.notes: Standard exterior siding sheens. Satin is most common default. Flat for budget/rental. Semi-gloss for high-visibility accent.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: SF is primary UOM for siding field. EA for protection items and edge seal count. LF for caulk joints. FIXED for tool cleaning.

substrate_state.notes: ALL SS_EXT_* states are proposed additions to controlled_enums.json. Interior-only states (SS_BARE, SS_PRIMED, etc.) do NOT apply. SS_EXT_FACTORY_FINISHED is new — not in existing doctrine substrate state tables. See registry_additions_proposed.

product_role.notes: Sealer for end-cut sealer product. No clear/stain/specialty needed.

protection_level.notes: No full_mask needed — exterior zones use lighter protection levels than interior spray.

surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs exist in id_registry → surface_ids → entries_in_active_use. Identical adjacency pattern to wood siding spec.

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC — similar acrylic primer concept but wood-specific
SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING — similar bonding concept but wood-specific
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD — same product tier, different substrate context
SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM — same product tier, different substrate context
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — interior bonding primer, different substrate

proposed_systems.name: Exterior Acrylic Field Primer for Fiber Cement
proposed_systems.notes: Standard 100% acrylic exterior primer over factory prime. Field prime is MANDATORY per James Hardie warranty.

proposed_systems.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement
proposed_systems.notes: Required for bare fiber cement (pH 13.0). Reference product: SW Loxon Masonry Primer. Prevents saponification/alkaline burn.

proposed_systems.name: Bonding Primer for Factory-Finished Fiber Cement
proposed_systems.notes: Required for ColorPlus/ExpertFinish factory-finished surfaces. Oven-baked finish is non-standard substrate for field paint adhesion.

proposed_systems.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Fiber Cement
proposed_systems.notes: 100% acrylic exterior latex. Hardie-approved products (SW Duration or equivalent). QT2 may use single coat.

proposed_systems.name: Premium Exterior Finish for Fiber Cement
proposed_systems.notes: Premium materials (SW Emerald, BM Aura — Hardie-approved). Light sand between coats. Raking light inspection.

material_system_prefix.notes: 3 substrate-driven primers + 2 QT-driven finish systems. No QT5 (excluded for siding field). Finish systems use Hardie-approved products for warranty compliance.

proposed_consumables.name: Fiber Cement End-Cut Edge Sealer
proposed_consumables.notes: Specific to fiber cement. Seals field-cut edges to prevent capillary moisture absorption. Critical for FM-001 prevention.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 517 (lap/panel siding)
proposed_consumables.notes: 515 or 517 for lap/panel siding. Separate from wood siding tips — may differ in wear profile on cementitious substrate.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 413 (shingle profile)
proposed_consumables.notes: 413 for shingle profiles — smaller pattern for complex geometry.

proposed_consumables.name: Exterior Flexible Paintable Caulk
proposed_consumables.notes: Polyurethane or siliconized acrylic for siding-to-trim joints. Do NOT caulk field butt joints (moisture trap).

proposed_consumables.name: 60-Mesh Spray Filter (Black) for Latex
proposed_consumables.notes: Standard 60-mesh (black) filter for latex exterior coatings through airless equipment.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 prime + 2 finish coats — standard NC sequence at QT3/QT4
1 prime + 1 finish coat — economy QT2 on primed surfaces
2 finish coats only — when field prime already applied (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FIELD)
1 finish coat only — economy QT2 on field-primed surface

proposed_profiles.description: Field primer coverage on fiber cement — 300-350 SF/gal smooth, adjusted by surface_factor for textured
Alkali-resistant primer coverage on bare fiber cement — 250-300 SF/gal (lower coverage due to porous bare substrate)
Finish coat coverage on primed fiber cement — 300-400 SF/gal smooth, adjusted by surface_factor for textured

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Window/door protection is NOT this spec's responsibility (RC-001 from wood siding). Trim, soffit, and fascia are separate spec scopes. No cross-spec flags needed at this time.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by siding profile
proposed_modifiers.notes: Lap is baseline. Panel slightly slower (fewer joints but larger single runs). Shingle is dramatically slower (many edges, constant repositioning).

proposed_modifiers.description: Material and production modifier by surface texture
proposed_modifiers.notes: Applies to BOTH material quantity and production rate. Textured profiles absorb more product and spray slower.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup → prep → prime → apply → interstage → finish → cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_FCSD_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: ITM_SIDING_FIELD MUST be used exactly as registered (existing ID)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Fiber Cement Siding Prime and Paint
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for fiber cement siding — distinct from SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT due to different substrate chemistry (pH 13.0 cementitious), primer requirements (alkali-resistant), application constraints (no back-rolling), and factory-finish handling (ColorPlus).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior siding field surface
registry_additions_proposed.justification: EXISTING — update used_in to include SF_SIDING_FIBERCEMENT_EXT_NC. No new ID needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Factory-primed exterior substrate
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Exterior-specific substrate state per Substrate_State_Reference.md §4. Not yet in controlled_enums valid_values. Should have been added with SF_WOOD_SIDING_EXT_NC_PAINT — both specs need it.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bare fiber cement (pH 13.0, no factory primer)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Fiber cement-specific bare state per Substrate_State_Reference.md §4. Required for alkali-resistant primer routing.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Field-primed exterior substrate (ready for topcoat)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Exterior-specific primed state per Substrate_State_Reference.md §4. Split-mobilization scenario where prime and finish are separated.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Factory-finished exterior substrate (ColorPlus/ExpertFinish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: NEW state for factory-finished fiber cement products damaged during construction. Not in existing doctrine substrate state tables. Added per user correction RC-001 — common NC scenario requiring bonding primer.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior painted finish — flat sheen
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Output state for completed exterior painting. Not yet in controlled_enums valid_values.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior painted finish — satin sheen
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Output state for completed exterior painting. Default exterior siding sheen. Not yet in controlled_enums valid_values.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior painted finish — semi-gloss sheen
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Output state for completed exterior painting. Not yet in controlled_enums valid_values.

registry_additions_proposed.name: New Construction Boolean Flag
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Boolean flag for engine-level NC context validation. Prevents accidental spec assignment to repaint projects.

registry_additions_proposed.name: New Construction Flag Input
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_META.FLAG.NEW_CONSTRUCTION. BOOL UOM type.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Landscape Protection Perimeter (LF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: LF-based landscape protection — measured along house perimeter where landscape is adjacent, not as area. Replaces SF-based PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.LANDSCAPE_ADJACENT and PS_EXT_PROTECT_SF.LANDSCAPE_FULL for this spec. You measure the run along the house, not the area of landscape beds.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Landscape Protection Perimeter Input (LF)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Input mapped to PS_EXT_PROTECT_LF.LANDSCAPE_PERIMETER. LF UOM.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Acrylic Field Primer for Fiber Cement
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Standard acrylic primer over factory prime — distinct from SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC which targets wood substrate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer for Bare Fiber Cement
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Required for pH 13.0 bare fiber cement. No existing system covers this — SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_ACRYLIC is not alkali-resistant.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bonding Primer for Factory-Finished Fiber Cement
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Required for ColorPlus/ExpertFinish oven-baked factory finish. Distinct from SYS_PRIMER_BONDING (interior smooth/hard substrates) and SYS_EXT_WOOD_PRIMER_BONDING (existing exterior coatings on wood).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Standard Exterior Acrylic Finish for Fiber Cement
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT2/QT3 finish system. Same product class as SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_STANDARD but fiber cement-specific context for coverage rates and warranty tracking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Premium Exterior Finish for Fiber Cement
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT4 finish system. Hardie-approved premium products (SW Emerald, BM Aura). Distinct from SYS_EXT_WOOD_FINISH_PREMIUM for coverage rate and warranty compliance tracking.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fiber Cement Field Primer Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Fiber cement primer coverage differs from wood siding (300-350 SF/gal smooth vs wood's rates). Surface texture modifier applies.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Alkali-Resistant Primer Coverage Profile for Bare FC
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Lower coverage on porous bare fiber cement (250-300 SF/gal). Distinct from standard primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fiber Cement Finish Coat Coverage Profile
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Fiber cement finish coverage (300-400 SF/gal smooth). Surface texture modifier applies.
